Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reaching out. I’m glad to hear you’ve received the contract.

Regarding your questions on the payment terms and the non-compete clause, I am happy to discuss both. Let’s schedule a brief call to negotiate the net-30 structure and review the non-compete adjustments to ensure they are equitable for both parties. I will send over a calendar invite shortly so we can find a time that works for you.

On a separate note, as a quick reminder for your records: pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
